ice_hockey_critical: THE CENTRAL DISTINCTION: three-way (1X2/'60 min') settles on REGULATION ONLY - a team winning in OT LOSES the three-way on it while WINNING the moneyline. ~22-25% of NHL games reach OT. Never treat the two prices as one market.

1xBET-FAMILY WARNING (Betwinner): totals and handicaps frequently default to REGULATION time unless labelled 'incl. OT' - the same 'Over 5.5' can be two different products. Scope must be part of market identity. If terms don't state it, STOP and confirm.
Shootout credits exactly ONE deciding goal (2-2 finishes 3-2), credited to no player: adds exactly +1 to OT-inclusive totals, can never cover -1.5, settles no goalscorer prop.
NHL playoffs: no shootout, no ties, unlimited 20-min periods - three-way should not exist, OT-inclusive totals have a fat right tail.
Empty-net goals push one-directionally toward OVER and favourite -1.5, and kill the draw late - a 1-goal-game model without ENG misprices the puck line AND the 1X2-vs-ML gap.
baseball_critical: 5-INNING RULE with ASYMMETRIC settlement: moneyline settles as ACTION once official (5 or 4.5 innings) while run line and totals typically need the FULL game and VOID otherwise - the same rain-shortened game pays the ML and refunds the total. Betwinner's thresholds MUST be read.

Listed-pitcher rule: a scratch voids ML at listed-pitcher books, but 1xBet-family books often settle as ACTION because no pitcher is named - a pitcher-matchup edge may not survive the scratch and you keep the risk without the reason.
Home team doesn't bat in the 9th when leading: home margins cap at +1 except walk-off HR - home -1.5 run lines lose coverage; home totals structurally suppressed.
MLB automatic runner from the 10th (regular season ONLY): extras are OVER-biased where it applies, completely different in postseason.
NPB/KBO allow TIES (12-inning cap): their 'moneyline' can PUSH - not the same instrument as an MLB moneyline.
Doubleheader 7-inning games where used: a 9-inning total on a 7-inning game is structurally too high - key totals to scheduled innings.
american_football_critical: Spread, total and moneyline INCLUDE overtime unless labelled 'regulation'; quarter/half markets exclude it - a full-game total is NOT the sum of its half totals.
NFL regular-season TIE is real: two-way moneyline PUSHES while spread and total settle - and playoffs have no tie.
NCAA overtime is a different game: possessions from the 25, mandatory 2-pt from 2nd OT, alternating 2-pt attempts from 3rd - NFL OT assumptions on NCAA are a direct pricing error.
Margins are LUMPY: 3 (~14-15%) then 7 (~9%). A half-point across 3 costs ~25-30 cents of juice; across 5, almost nothing. NEVER linearly interpolate alternate spreads across 3/7/10/6/14.
Venue change: most books VOID everything; neutral site removes ~1.5-2.5 pts of HFA - venue is part of staleness, not just changedAt.
